documents.title: Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018
Disclosures under Reg. 29(2) of SEBI (SAST) Regulations, 2011
Disclosure Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI (LODR) Regulations 2015- ESG Rating

analysis.summary: Mayur Uniquoters reported Q1 FY27 standalone revenue of INR247.03 crores and consolidated revenue of INR269.23 crores, reflecting strong year-on-year growth driven mainly by mix changes and export performance. Management highlighted ongoing capacity expansions through a new production line expected to start by February or March 2027, alongside evaluation of a potential international facility. Despite cost headwinds from raw materials and elevated freight rates, the company remains focused on maintaining stable margins and achieving long-term growth across its export and domestic OEM markets. Mayur Uniquoters Limited reported its Q4 and FY26 financial results, highlighting strong year-on-year growth in standalone and consolidated revenues, profit before tax, and profit after tax. Management noted that raw material prices for paste PVC had increased significantly with availability stabilizing, while export momentum, especially in the automotive segment, contributed positively to margins.

guidance.claim: The company expects domestic growth between 8% and 10%.
guidance.quote: So, we have said in the last phone call also, our expectation from domestic growth is between 8%-10%.

guidance.claim: The company expects export growth from 15% to 20%.
guidance.quote: And our expectation from export growth is from 15%-20%.

guidance.claim: The value growth will be approximately the same in this year and the next 2-3 years.
guidance.quote: I am still waiting. So, we have said that between 8%-10%, the value will be approximately the same in this year and the next 2-3 years.

guidance.claim: Management targets a 15% growth potential in the coming year.
guidance.quote: So we have kept potential outlook for 15% growth in the coming year also.

guidance.claim: Management stated that the value growth is projected at 15% on average for the next two years, with margins remaining at more or less similar levels.

demand_outlook.claim: The footwear segment experienced a muted market due to drastic increases in raw material and sole prices.
demand_outlook.quote: So obviously, the market was muted in the footwear segment.

demand_outlook.claim: Management notes that India's signing of a free trade agreement is a very positive move, creating better cost effectiveness and improved customer procurement sentiments, particularly in the European market.
demand_outlook.quote: I think so it's a very positive move for India. Definitely, we will be more effective in terms of cost. The sentiments of the customers to procure from India will definitely increase. So and definitely both especially in the Europe market, I mean very good sentiments are coming.

demand_outlook.claim: The company anticipates strong growth in the export market.
demand_outlook.quote: But yes, we are looking at a very strong growth in the export market.

demand_outlook.claim: Automotive sector is experiencing more growth in both domestic and international markets.
demand_outlook.quote: Obviously, we are focusing more on the automotive sector. So, we see more growth coming from the automotive side, whether it's in the domestic market or in the international market.

demand_outlook.claim: PU business is still muted right now.
demand_outlook.quote: So, PU, still the business is muted right now.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that the European automotive industry is experiencing a story of degrowth.
demand_outlook.quote: But if you see, European automotive industry is not growing as much rather than it's -- there is a story of degrowth over there.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has ordered a new line for expansion in its current premises, expected to start production between February and March 2027 with an additional capacity of 5 lakh meters.
capex_expansion.quote: So we should be able to start our production by -- towards the end of this financial year, somewhere between February, March 2027. So we'll have an additional production capacity of 5 lakh meters.

capex_expansion.claim: Instead of putting a coating line in South India, space has been found in an existing facility to increase capacity.
capex_expansion.quote: In India, we have ordered a coating line. But instead of putting it in South India, we have found space in an existing facility only. So, we will put it here. So, our capacity will increase.

capex_expansion.claim: A global location expansion for a new plant entails a capex around INR 300 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: But the CAPEX would be around INR 300 Cr for a global location.

capex_expansion.claim: The ordered coating line for the existing location should be done by the end of the calendar year.
capex_expansion.quote: We have already ordered for an existing location. So, by the end of this calendar year, it should be done.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated that a global scale capex would require INR 300 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: If we do on a global scale, it will be INR300 crores over there.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated that once a decision is taken, it takes approximately 2 years for the plant to start.
capex_expansion.quote: So once the decision is taken, it takes approximately 2 years for the plant to start.

margins_costs.claim: Sustainable margins are expected to be around 25% plus 1% or 2%.
margins_costs.quote: No. This margin is -- actually, we told you earlier also in our previous con call that margin -- sustainable margin will be 25 plus 1% or 2%.

margins_costs.claim: The margin in the previous quarter was abnormally high due to an abnormal increase in foreign exchange rates.
margins_costs.quote: But last quarter, it was abnormally high because of foreign exchange increase in -- abnormally high increase in foreign exchange rates. So that was a onetime increase basically.

margins_costs.claim: Shipment costs increased significantly during the quarter, reaching levels 4x higher.
margins_costs.quote: It's 4x higher, the shipment cost was increased.

margins_costs.claim: Paste PVC prices have gone up significantly, creating an initial challenge regarding availability.
margins_costs.quote: So, obviously, it's a petroleum by-product. So, the prices have gone up and the prices have gone up significantly. So, there was a challenge initially in the month of March where people were expecting that there could be an issue regarding the availability of the raw material.

margins_costs.claim: Raw material prices have softened a little bit from the highs of March.
margins_costs.quote: And prices have also softened a little bit from the highs of March.

margins_costs.claim: Employee benefit expenses were impacted by the new labor codes and new hiring.
margins_costs.quote: No, actually it has impact of new labor codes provisional impact, that is the impact employee benefit expenses and new hiring is also.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that imports account for nearly one-third of total raw material costs.
margins_costs.quote: Normally, imports are nearly 1/3 of our total raw material cost.

margins_costs.claim: Management reported that plasticizers and yarn prices have started going up.
margins_costs.quote: In fact, plasticizers prices have started going up. Yarn prices have started going up.

orders_capacity.claim: Current capacity utilization is running between 75% and 78%.
orders_capacity.quote: So, we are utilizing somewhere between 75% to 78%.

orders_capacity.claim: The company registered a total volume of 31 million meters.

orders_capacity.quote: Volume growth is a total 4.5%. Nearly 5%.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management cited market volatility and various disruptions such as Trump tariffs and the West Asia war affecting plant location decisions.
risks_headwinds.quote: But because of all this Trump tariff, the West Asia war or multiple things happening in the last few years, we have not taken a final call where -- which should be the ideal location to put our plant.

risks_headwinds.claim: Short-term impact on domestic business can occur because it takes time to pass on price increases to customers.
risks_headwinds.quote: Short-term, yes, maybe a month or so. Because it takes some time to pass on the price increase to the customers. Definitely, it impacts a little bit in the short-term.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that the world is moving towards deglobalization as a reason for evaluating a plant outside India.
risks_headwinds.quote: But world is moving towards deglobalization also. So as a counter measure, those things we are evaluating to put up a plant somewhere, not taking a final call there, but somewhere outside India definitely.

management_commitments.claim: Production from the new expansion line in the current premises is expected to start between February and March 2027.
management_commitments.quote: So we should be able to start our production by -- towards the end of this financial year, somewhere between February, March 2027.

management_commitments.claim: US business sales and automotive volume are projected to increase by 60% to 70% over the next three years.
management_commitments.quote: Sir we have already told that our US business will increase and next in next three years the business will almost be if not double at least 60%, 70% our US business will increase, right? In terms of US automotive.

management_commitments.claim: The increased export momentum is expected to continue in the next 2 to 3 years.
management_commitments.quote: And this increased momentum is expected to continue in the next 2-3 years.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that the increased export momentum is expected to continue in the next 2 to 3 years.
management_commitments.quote: And this increased momentum is expected to continue in the next 2, 3 years.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
